reviews.text: everyone here was super kind and helpful! they explained everything to me and gave me options and I was in and out in 30 minutes!

Dear Katie,

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a perfect 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience at Bond Vet - Lakeview. Our team is dedicated to providing the best care possible for your furry family members, and it’s wonderful to know that our efforts made a difference for you.

If you have any more feedback or need assistance in the future, please don't hesitate to reach out. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again!

Warm regards,

The Bond Vet - Lakeview Team
Our dog Bruce pooped on Dr Zendeja and Ciara and they were still so nice and helpful and  excellent!!!!
Would rate it higher but its a bit pricey.  They did get me out of a jam.

This was the best place we could’ve gone for urgent care. We will be establishing care here going forward. The doctors and the entire team were phenomenal for such a last-minute scary event for us. I cannot say enough good things about this place assured me as a pet parent gave everything to me clear as possible and did it in a cost efficient way

Hello Emily,

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience at Bond Vet - Lakeview. Our team is dedicated to providing the best care possible for your furry friends, and it’s wonderful to know that we met your expectations. If you ever have any questions or need further assistance, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!

Warm regards,  
The Bond Vet - Lakeview Team
Wonderful! Easy going and down to earth.. Dr.  Was fantastic! Recommended only what needed to be done...
They quoted me $600 to get my cat spayed.

Coming to Bond Vet Lakeview was such a lovely experience! You walk in to a clean, open waiting room with treats available. The front desk greeted us and took us to the room almost immediately. We were brining in kittens, so they brought a lot of attention from staff. The kittens were allowed to explore the room, and there was an assortment of treats for free. The staff was so kind, descriptive, and open to questions. It was a quick, stress free experience for my kitties. Loved everything about it, we will be coming back!
ai phone bot 🙄 and it’s not even a good one.

Dear Danielle,

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a perfect 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience at Bond Vet - Lakeview. Our team is dedicated to providing the best care possible for your pets, and your feedback is incredibly rewarding.

If you have any further questions or need assistance in the future, please don't hesitate to reach out. We look forward to seeing you and your furry friends again soon!

Warm regards,

The Bond Vet - Lakeview Team

2 stars for being able to get my dog in on short notice when needed and for the experienced Tech that was honest and more clear than the doctors. After over a year of leaving the office confused every time about what was going on or what I needed to do next we finally switched vets. The last straw was dropping off a sample for urinalysis and having someone call and ask what we brought it for, then having our actual vet call days later and say they just didn’t scroll down far enough in the chart to know what additional tests were needed so we’d need to do another test, bring another sample in, and pay another $120. This was after they sent us home with a cancer diagnosis that our new vet confirmed there is no evidence of. I get that corporate practices are doing their best while having their labor hours slashed and having to see a wild number of pets per day but this is the result. If I can’t trust the entire practice to communicate clearly and work efficiently, I can’t trust you with my pets care.

Dear Aurélie,

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a perfect 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience at Bond Vet - Lakeview. Our team is dedicated to providing the best care possible for your pets, and your feedback is incredibly rewarding. If you have any further comments or need assistance in the future, please don't hesitate to reach out. We look forward to seeing you and your furry friends again!

Warm regards,

The Bond Vet - Lakeview Team

I planned on writing a review ages ago but needed some time. In December of last year, we had to lay our cat Fiona to rest. It was really hard on myself and my partner but I cannot speak highly enough about Dr. Novak and the care that was given to not only Fiona but us as well. We had a private euthanasia and also had the private cremation done. We are happy to have a piece of our beloved cat with us forever and can’t thank Dr. Novak enough for taking care of us. My one and only complaint in Bond Vet using an AI phone operator to reach someone at the location. Otherwise, we would use Bond Vet again in the future.
What a wonderful, caring Vet experience!  So kind, always on time, and clearly care about each patient with a smile.  Makes this pet parent feel good!

Kiwi needed to get checked asap and unfortunately his regular vet couldn’t see him the same day . And with just a call and no appointment they told me to bring him in and I did. Once I got there I only Had to wait less than 5 minutes for them to take him in and they checked him and we were out from there in less than 30 minutes relieved. Thank you ❤️
The Lakeview location of Bond Vet is the best! We bring our Golden Retriever Glen here every few months and they are always so helpful, reliable, and kind.

Bond Vet has such a caring and attentive staff. They make hard visits smooth, and have such a gorgeous space which makes all the difference in the world. Could not recommend enough!! Thank you to every care giver who has seen our Rue girl!
Always able to get my cat in to Bond right away, staff is very kind! :)
Very friendly reception and took great care of my dog Karl!

Love this location! A year or so ago, one of our cats needed a hygienic shave, and she needed it immediately. I called around to so many vets trying to get a last second appointment for her and none were available. BondVet Lakeview was happy to take her ASAP. She is usually very scared and hostile at the vet, but their professionalism and care kept her unusually calm. I moved all three of our cats records over to them pretty soon after. We now go once a month for one of our other cats preventative shots. The pricing is reasonable, the doctors are knowledgeable and the staff is incredibly kind. Thank you Lakeview!!!
very quick, professional, and kind!!
Great experience!
Lovely people and a great vet!! Highly recommend!

Great experience. Quiet and peaceful for pets.
Online booking 7 days a week is great for weekend emergencies. Brought dog last week cat this week.

This visit was a scary one for us with our new puppy. Lauren N explained everything, step by step, and provided us with choices of care. She and the staff made us less anxious and we knew our puppy was in excellent hands
Called to ask some questions about establishing care and Emily was SO helpful! Love when it’s easy to get set up at a new vet.
Beautiful clinic and knowledgeable staff. Able to answer all of my questions as a first time pet owner!
Great staff and phenomenal experience!

Fantastic vet - they helped my dog after she ate a kong bone. They were close to closing and still took time to take care of her even though she had never been seen there before. They helped induce nausea and helped prevent an obstruction. I was so pleased with their care and willingness to help. I highly recommend Dr Kubala, Emily (reception) and Caitie (Tech). They were so professional and supportive in a very stressful situation and took the best care of my baby.
Good doctors and short wait times. Recommended.

Dear Tyler,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that your experience didn’t meet your expectations. At Bond Vet, we aim to provide compassionate, high-quality care, and your input helps us improve. Please reach out to the phone number I left on your voicemail so we can better understand what happened and make it right.

Warm regards,

Bond Vet - Lakeview Team

Most incredible vet visit I've ever experienced. The staff was wonderful; from Emily warmly greeting my dog and me, to nurse Katie and Dr. Lam giving the most considerate and personalized care, it was remarkable. I'm so thankful and appreciative to everyone who helped us, and I highly recommend Bond Vet to anyone who's looking for exceptional care for their pets.

This place will rob you blind ! They charge $165 for a cytopoint injection. My dog has gotten this shot at Vetco, Banfield, and Wrigleyville Veterinary for $85. They literally doubled the price! DO NOT GO THERE ! My dog needed it so I had to pay the price but I will never go back . People were nice and friendly but sorry your prices are beyond unreasonable.

I love this place they are amazing and open 7 days a week. All the doctors are so sweet and so helpful and Lily, Emily and all the nurses are amazing I 1000% recommend this place and it’s the only place I trust taking my son (dog)
Allie and Emily are rockstars at the Bond Vet in Lakeview. They were so kind, thoughtful and helpful with me and my sick pup.

I take my cat here when necessary because it’s extremely convenient however, I prefer my primary vet over this place, which happens to be in Minnesota. This place offers great care and expertise however, it is just extremely expensive. I do feel like they nickel and dime for every single thing during a visit and always require a follow up visit where you end up spending more money during the follow up. I have also had two times where they either forgot to trim my cats nails or said they weren’t able to. Overall, this place is just OK and it gets the job done, but I only go here when it’s extremely necessary. Everything else like my cats annual exam and dental cleaning, I bring to my favorite vet in Minnesota, which is a fraction of the cost
Bondvet is great! They really care, are compassionate and knowledgeable.

Poor poor service I’ve spent over $2000 dollars trying to figure out why my dog continues to get ear infections for me to walk out not knowing the underlying issue my $400/$500 every visit my most recent visit I took my baby for ear cleaning and and nail clipping for them to not wanna touch him and sent me home with supply’s to do it myself and I still end up paying the price as if I paid the service for them to do it then I give a bad review the manager calls me to resolve the issue and that was to come back in and pay for the treatment all over again but I must sedate my dog first before he comes in then proceed to ban me because I’m mad that I have to keep spending money only for them to not know why his ears get infected so often 0/10 not recommended at all

Everyone here is so immensely helpful and kind! They make sure to focus on making the animals comfortable while still making sure they get checked out, and they’re confident in a way that adds to making pets and pet caretakers calm and comfortable as well. Absolutely amazing!
Awesome . Quick and friendly. They treated both my kitties like royalty

Read before you waste your time and money at this place.

Bond Vet is an incompetent provider. I took my one-year-old cat in for what Bond Vet told us was simply an upper respiratory infection. They gave us a supplement, and told us to come back if it didn't work. He only became sicker, and so we went back to Bond Vet for a second visit. This time, they gave him a round of oral antibiotics and a cream for his eye, which was irritated as an effect of the infection. We gave him the full round of orally administered antibiotics, and found that he still showed very little improvement. We took him in to Bond Vet a third time, where they gave him a long-acting version of the same antibiotic administered as a shot, and told us that if this doesn't work we should bring him in for an X-ray. throughout our visits they suggested expensive scans which we declined. Once again, there was a short period of improvement and a quick reversion to his initial level of illness. At this point we decided to look for other care, and found a different vet office (Fauna on Lawrence). Upon requesting that Bond Vet send my cat's files over to this different office, they claimed they had never treated him, and that all they had on record was a single cancelled appointment. Once we went to the second vet, they immediately told us it was actually a Feline Herpes Virus flare-up that could not effectively be treated with "chronic antibiotics". They gave us much better care and information. Bond Vet is either entirely incompetent or were trying to milk money out of us, like many other vet chains.

-Update
They just called me my personal number to ask about this review. They were able to transfer the files in the call, but that was not the reason for the call. They claimed that I had declined PCR tests but I remember distinctly what I was offered in the appointments I took him to and I was not offered any tests, if I was it was spoken about as something for the next appointment if the second round of antibiotics doesn't work. feline herpes was also not mentioned to me verbally. the family member who took him to the first appointment there also does not recall being offered a PCR test, or having it mentioned.

The fact that they were able to trace this review back to my file, but were unable to transfer said files to a different vet is indicative of some irresponsible practices here.

If it is not already obvious, I highly recommend that you steer clear of this vet. After doing more research and finding more reviews I have seen many stories just like mine.
Great staff and experience!
Always provide a caring and focused approach to my dog. They are very helpful when trying to figure out what is happening.

We had an excellent experience at this clinic. We came as an urgent care appointment that was easy to schedule online. The staff was kind, patient, and knowledgeable. The clinic is very nice and clean. I have an anxious dog but he felt at ease there. Would definitely recommend!

My experience with this vet is incredible every time! Natalie is the absolute best! Always super super helpful and patient. I find the messaging system to the doctors to be efficient and they always respond in a timely manner. The lobby and rooms are always very clean and welcoming. These are my first kitties and I could not have chosen a better vet!
My dog Archie has been treated here ever since we moved to Chicago! He has received the best care. We always get appointments easily and never have to wait long to be seen. Highly recommend!
I really liked going to Bond Vet for the care of my cat. Dr. Novak and the nurse Mel were kind and answered all my questions regarding treatment and next steps.

DO NOT RECOMMEND if you have a dog with any sort of anxiety. My dog has never had an aggressive behavior at a vet until visiting this location. The vet and assistant came in with a bad vibe off the bat, not friendly or comforting to me or my dog who was there for an emergency, making my dog uncomfortable and even more nervous. They took my dog without me to a kennel and the assistant was allegedly bit in the process of trying to put my dog in the kennel. They made us go through a whole thing with verifying rabies vaccinations (that part was fine) and forced us to return for a second appointment (that we obviously had to pay for) to confirm my dog still didn’t have rabies 🙄 I will never forget the sound of my dog literally screaming in pain when you were removing her broken toenail - it was genuinely horrendous as well and VERY prolonged. Would have never come here if it hadn’t been an emergency.
Amazing vet - super kind and reasonable prices. Great with our anxious/reactive dog.

I can’t say enough good things about Bond Vet in Lakeview. Every experience I’ve had with them has been amazing — they’re incredibly patient, kind, and communicative, and they always make both me and my dog, Parker, feel completely cared for.

They’ve never kept us waiting, the facility is clean and welcoming, and the whole team is professional and compassionate. I especially appreciate how they take the time to clearly explain Parker’s needs, provide treatment options, and always share cost estimates upfront. It’s such a relief to know I’m getting affordable, transparent care from people who truly love animals.

Highly recommend Bond Vet to any pet parent looking for trustworthy, reliable care in Chicago!
Banfield pet clinic in South Elgin is a great clinic for my cat Black Betty!   So personable and caring!    I highly recommend !
Horrible customer service.  My cat was diagnosed with stage 2 renal failure and I can’t get a person to take a call.   Stuck in phone system hangups or chatbot hell.
Very good and friendly staff treated my fur baby with the utmost respect

They are the best they helped us save you’re baby Mary Jane when she needed emergency surgery they went above and beyond  they called the next day to check on her  I thank them from the bottom of my of you’re hearts I would recommend them to everyone  the doctors and nurses are amazing there

I love this vet. I originally went to bondvet in new York but when I moved to Chicago they didn’t have a bond vet (yet). But in 2023 they opened up Bond Vet in Lakeview and I’ve been come here ever since. Nurse Mel was very kind and attentive to Rollie’s need.

If your looking for a Vet, Bond Vet Lakeview is your place

We had a wonderful experience with our dog here about a month ago when she was bit by another dog early on a Sunday morning and we wanted to get her checked out right away. We were also able to get her up to date with vaccinations. Everyone at Bond Vet Lakeview was so kind, patient, and caring in a difficult situation with what other services had classified as a difficult dog. We are grateful for their services and will continue to use them.

First time going and couldn't be happier with Bond Lakeview! It's obvious that they care much more about your pet's well-being than making money off of you. The receptionist was a little unfriendly, though, both in-person and over the phone.
Excellent knowledge doctors and staff.

I've had great experiences at Bond Vet Lakeview with my dog and cat. Dr. Novak and Erika were very patient and kind with my large German Shepherd. I especially appreciated that they prioritized positive reinforcement over restraining him. The receptionist, Marlen, was very kind, attentive, and answered all my questions.

I brought my kitten in with her official vaccine passport, which clearly showed she already had two FVRCP doses and the rabies vaccine. The clinic copied the records but later told me she had no vaccines at all and needed all three FVRCP shots.
Trusting their judgment, I let them give her another dose. Days later, I rechecked her passport and confirmed she already had two. Only after I followed up and sent proof did they admit they overlooked it, blaming it on the records being in another language.
They then told me she needed the third anyway, completely missing the point. I was misinformed due to their lack of diligence, and had I not caught it myself, my cat could have been over-vaccinated.
Saying she needed the third dose anyway ignores the core issue. This was a failure to properly review records and communicate with care.
Although they eventually acknowledged the mistake, it only happened because I followed up. This experience has affected my trust in the clinic. I hope others double check, as the lack of diligence and accountability was deeply disappointing.
BondVet has been great for my highly sensitive big baby lab rescue. They’ve been super easy to work with, patent and my lab gives the unlimited free treats 4 paws up!
Excellent sense of expertise, sensitivity, caring and service!  I am so thankful that BondVet has a Lakeview location so close to me!

Unfortunately was quite disappointed with my experience at this vet. While they are a nice place and have some really kind people working here, unfortunately the caliber of their expertise is quite limited. They also are way too expensive. I would only recommend this place if your pet is healthy and needs checkups or if you have pet insurance. Even then, I would proceed with caution.

My cat was fairly sick, and they ended up misdiagnosing him multiple times. They first said constipation, then maybe heart failure, maybe sepsis, then certainly a urinary blockage (even though he peed once he got home). The medical director here consistently tried to tell us our cat was blocked and had horrible bedside manner, threatening us that if we didn’t shell out $1k then our cat could die in the next 24 hours. I have never been so stressed at a vet in my life. After getting a second opinion from a different vet at another establishment who is specialized in cats, we found out that he had an ear infection causing severe vertigo. In truth, BondVet did not do a thorough enough exam of our cat and it led to a misdiagnosis and a loss of $3.5k.

I’m only giving this 2 stars instead of 1 because at the end of the day, they still cared about our cat.

Elisa and Dr. Berlin were wonderful in helping my pup's ear infection! From keeping him calm and comfortable during an uncomfortable ear exam to teaching me how to give his medicines, I'd trust them with any of my pets. The ability to quickly get on the schedule is a lifesaver for these urgent care cases. Thank you, Elisa and Dr. Berlin!

Visited Sunday and was charged 850$ just for blood work on my dog . My dog had been throwing up, diarrhea and was bleeding in her stool. They’re very friendly but did not attend correctly, they charged an over priced amount to initially not give my dog any medicine and just directed us to an ER. While the next day we went to a different clinic who charged 250$ for labs , radiology imaging and proper medicine to cure my dog and catch what was wrong with her .
This is the best vet I have ever taken my dog to! They always treat my pup great and have good pricing. Would highly recommend.
Bennys first vet appointment at Bond was great! Everyone we came into contact with was super kind and helpful, and so nice to our boy :)

My cat had a surgery at Bond Vet on 12/4 and during the surgery his sciatic nerve was damaged, likely from IV administration of the anesthesia. He was unable to use his back left leg at all and had no feeling in the limb.

I reached out 12/5 because the evening after I picked him up and again in the morning he was dragging his leg and they told me it was the anesthesia wearing off. He would struggle to climb into the litter box then fall over and lay there. The person who emailed me back suggested trying different litter.

He ended up with a wound from dragging his foot on the ground and on 12/6 I reached out again because the size of the wound was growing and he started to lick and bite at his leg. I started to suspect it might be a nerve issue because he had 0 feeling at all in that limb. After a phone call they they suggested that if I was "that concerned [I] could bring him in tomorrow."

After the short visit on 12/7 they agreed there was definitely an issue and referred me to a vet neurologist who confirmed that his nerve had been damaged and the leg would likely need to be amputated.

My cat had to stay in a crate for ~1.5 months so that he couldn't walk too much and damage his foot more while we waited to see if it improved. After some time he started to re-gain feeling and use, but because of the pain he was still chewing on the leg. He had to be in a cone taking pregabalin until April while the neurologist and I played the waiting game to see if total use would return and if the pain would subside enough. His leg did heal after several months and the neurologist told me he was very surprised because we both thought it would need to be amputated.

I understand that mistakes happen, but having to bother Bond Vet via email and phone call for several days and getting suggestions like changing the litter type left a bad taste in my mouth. Particularly because the televet and emergency vet I spoke to before I brought him in again both suspected it was a nerve issue from a 5 minute conversation.
Very quick and easy and always helpful with my dog who has a lot of anxiety at the vet.

My two cats have been seen at this vet for over a year. The prices have gone up exponentially while the service has gone down. I reached out to Bond Vet for international travel certifications for both of my cats, they use a third party service to submit the documentation. They quoted me $650 - $1100 for each pet which is absurd. I called three other USDA vets in Chicago that provided estimates that are half the price of this. We'll no longer be clients of Bond, unfortunate that they are this greedy.
I love Bond Vet. I can tell they really care about my cat’s well-being while she’s there. They’re very gentle and kind, handling her with care every visit:)
My dog Crouton loves Bond Vet- the space is super comfortable and the staff is very friendly. I would recommend Bond Vet to any Chicago pet owner!!!
Best vet in the area. Fantastic staff.

Update - They did give me a call back and apologize and also provided me with a small discount for the mistake which is appreciated. If you’re new to the area this isn’t cheap, but it’s a decent vet if you have the funds and don’t mind a premium for a fancy atmosphere.

Beware — Cost Transparency Issue.
I called for an urgent visit for my dog’s bleeding nail and confirmed during booking that it would be a full checkup for $104 with a $50 new client discount. I was told everything would be included — his ears checked because he’d been shaking his head recently, his paw cleaned and dressed, and the hanging nail trimmed to prevent infection. None of that happened. At the appointment, they swabbed his ears (without warning it would cost $100 to test for infection), and the vet simply yanked the nail off with no cleaning or dressing just trauma for my dog who trusts vets even less now. I walked in expecting to pay $60–$100 max with meds and left with a $250+ bill. Completely misleading and disappointing
I’ve had great experiences at this clinic—they’ve been able to fit me in on short notice, the staff is warm, attentive, and cared about my cat and answered all my questions patiently. Recommended!

I needed to visit the pet urgent care on a Sunday. (For my cat) Was able to get an appt the day before.  Urgent care is way better than any ER vet around. Thanks for helping out on a Sunday afternoon. My cat is doing great.

Brought our dog in on Friday for an emergency involving lots of blood and vomit and left with a $1,000 bill for an x-ray and the incorrect medicine. Our dog almost dies hours later due to their medicine blunder. We ended up bringing her to MedVet and they revived her as she collapsed from blood loss. Imagine your beloved canine on brink of collapse and being trapped in a room with no windows as fine printed e-sign docs are required before performing Any check up. The staff isn't qualified to read x-rays so they send you a "telehealth/xray" bill for $611.65 so they can send the x-ray to someone who is qualified and have you wait as your dogs health slowly deteriorates. They tried scamming me for an additional $500 for blood work when all she needed was antibiotics and anti diarrhea medicine. The antibiotics that ended up saving our dogs life wasn't even mentioned during our visit. The $500 blood work was mentioned probably 20 times. The staff is young and inexperienced and most likely following whatever leadership directions are.
Leaderships Business Model:  Remove any accountability from ourselves via fine print e-signatures and then price gouge as much as possible, especially when our customers are stuck between a rock and a hard place. As we bend them over into poverty and bloody stool, make sure to strip valuable time away from them being able to save their pets life by employing the most unqualified vets. Using this tactic we can then use a 3rd party vendors for x-ray and blood work readings and gouge some more, while removing even more accountability from ourselves at the same time.  If the customer uses the bathroom, charge a water fee and disguise it in one of the medicines, if we give them a bag, opportunity to upcharge, wear and tear fee for sitting in our seats, sanitization fee for his sniffle. Always remember Sell, Sell, Sell. Here at Bond Vet we value unhealthy pets "Healthy Pets Don't Need Vets" and then we can't send our customers the electric bill for using our lights.
I would like to request a refund and an apology from the CEO Garrett Lewis.

Bond Vet - Lakeview is FANTASTIC. The office is immaculate, the staff are helpful and friendly, and they are definitely the most reasonably priced vet clinic I've been to. A special shout-out goes to Nurse Adriana and Dr. Jim Murnighan for their highly skillful handling of my dog Bandit during his assessment & for their high quality and clear communication of all of the information related to my visit. They're great!

*11/5 Stars*

Brought my dog, Rocco, into Bond after 4 days of diarrhea and a bloody poop. Having not expiereced this before with him, I was very worked up and upset, and everyone at Bond was so kind, understanding and reassuring. The treatments that they had given him + the probiotics and perscription food they gave us to take home had Rocco on the up and up by the next morning. I thought it was resonably priced, and I didn't feel pressured into any unncesscary bloodwork, testing, etc. Will be reccommending to all my pet mom/dad friends. Very grateful for everyone at Bond!
Incredible staff. Alexandra, our vet doctor(sorry I forgot your name!!) and Joy were all welcoming and made it a great experience. We’re coming here from now on.

My 11 yr old Border Collie mix wasn't eating very well for a few days. She would miss her morning meals and only eat at night. Then over the weekend would only eat very little in the morning and at night. I started to get worried as her energy started to decrease and she just wanted to lay down all day and nap. For a 11 yr old Border Collie mix she's very energetic, so seeing her just sleep most of the day and miss her meals raised a red flag. I have never been to Bond Vet but was recommended by a good friend to give them a call and see what they can do to help out my pup before I took her to the vet. When I called the amazing receptionist, Liz, took down all the information and reassured me that she can help me out and that she would be able to book me an app the next day to see the Vet for my pup. Liz advised me to feed my dog a blain diet of Chicken and Rice, keep an eye over her through out the day. If anything went wrong with the blain diet to call back and we can book an appt to see the Vet. I was able to book an appt with Liz to see Dr.Novak the next day at 10:30 am. I when I arrived Liz was ready to get my dog and I into the exam room. I informed her that my dog can be very reactive in stressful situations so she made sure no other animals were in the lobby or coming through the hallway while we walked to the exam room. Shortly after I was greeted by the Vet Tech Olivia, that took down more personal information about my dogs situation. Olivia was amazing and got down every detail about the situation and kept me posted on what exams my dog will be receiving today. She would pop in and out to give me updates about the situation and ran through prices and of all the exams they would be doing. Finally when all exams where done, Dr. Novak went into detail of my pups results, what next steps for her should be and the medication my dog would be getting today.  Thank you to the amazing staff at Bond Vet making me and my pup feel welcomed, understood and for making her feel better. Shortly after our visit to Bond Vet my pup came back to life, I would notice small increase coming back to her. Wonderful, supportive staff! I will definitely becoming back and making Bond Vet my primary care for my pup!

The office is so warm and welcoming! No scary steel tables or cold white clinic walls which made my pup feel much calmer. My dog is scared of men so they made sure she was cared for by female staff which I really appreciated!! They were so accommodating of her anxiety and let her take her time to calm down. This was the best vet visit she has ever had in her 3.5 years of living and I couldn’t recommend this office more!
The best vet experience I've ever had with my cat! The staff is incredibly gentle and kind, making a huge difference with their care and compassion.
Wildly expensive

Taking your pet to the vet is stressful but at Bond they really do make it as easy as possible. They were great with all 3 of my dogs and talked me through every part of the intake, examination, and billing process.

I want to write and express my rating is specific to one veterinarian. But that one vet is the reason we will never be returning to Bond.

First, the good. Our usual vet, Maria, has always been fantastic. Caring. Empathetic. Truly made us happy to choose this place for care for our corgi. If I was writing a review for just her, it would be 5 stars.

Unfortunately, our experience with travel vet Emma was so disastrous that I had to write this interview.

TLDR: Emma missed a kennel cough diagnosis that was described as "incredibly obvious" by another vet we took to after my dog's condition worsened.

Our corgi was feeling very cathartic, refusing to eat, coughing, and wheezing. We immediately got him into the first vet appointment we could get the next morning at Bond. Maria was not available but it didn't matter - we knew he needed care.

When in during the appointment, Emma was checking him out and when pressing into his stomach he reacted. We let her know that he actually just hates anyone touching his stomach and tolerates us - but she wouldn't move on from it. We even demonstrated that he would let us press on his stomach - mind you he was still wheezing and coughing.

She ordered blood work and xrays, and nearly $1000 later she sent him home with stomach meds and special food. She also told us "I am just a travel vet so I have no idea what the hours are here tomorrow but if he isn't better bring him back."

The vet DIDN'T KNOW THE HOURS OF THE PLACE THEY WERE WORKING.

Again, we were there because he was coughing and wheezing. Let me again say, hearing your dog wheeze to breathe is like absolutely heart wrenching. I stayed up with him all night knowing first thing we were going somewhere else. We called Bond back and they were able to prescribe us anti-biotics but we were so worried we went to another vet where they took our concerns so serious. They met us outside, removed anything in the room that would potentially make spreading it easier - and this was just the idea we thought he might have it. When they met him, it was "textbook kennel cough." He was medicated and recovered, but he spent a couple days sick because of Bond's travel vet.

If you have an established vet with Bond, I think they're great. But their travel vet, in my experience, cares only about transactional profit. She was dismissive, rude, and MISSED a major sickness.

We have since moved all care from Bond.
Visit was very efficient and friendly. Reasonably priced. Dr Novak and the staff were all very knowledgeable and friendly.

While recently at the vet with my friend for her dog to be seen. I was sitting in the room and while waiting for them to come back I could hear a vet in the other room continuously tell a dog they were seeing to “relax, stop being a bad girl, you’re gonna be alright just stop crying” the entire time I was there. They finally brought her out to her dad in the lobby and it was clear this dog was so stressed and anxious. Like I mentioned my dog is very anxious as well whenever we go to the vet which is why I give her a trazodone. When we sat in the back room I’ve never seen her panic like this and it was only her second visit. She was crying and jumping from my lap to the ground and tucking herself in a corner. I do not feel comfortable ever bringing her to this clinic again.

I’ve lived here four years and have been taking my dog to her vet in my hometown every year for her checkups. I was ready to finally find a new vet near us. The first time we went in was because she had an abscess under her eye. After talking w the nurse extensively they took her back and it was pretty quick. 20min tops, and the doctor came in and told me she had an infected tooth that was causing the abscess. Honestly her doctor was great - she gave a ton of details and answered all of my questions. However she told me she’d have to get it pulled and it would cost me $4,200. They prescribed an antibiotic and a painkiller to get rid of the infection and we left.
Where this visit took a turn for me was the next day when I called them concerned because the abscess had now popped and her face would not stop bleeding. They told me I could bring her back in but it would be a “revisit fee” which was only $10 less than her original exam fee which seemed weird to me. But they also said they close in an hour so apply cold water to her face. It felt like extreme lack of care as I was panicking on the phone with them. I sat her in the bathtub for 90min until her face stopped bleeding and continued to rinse w water.
The next day I sent her quote and summary  to her vet back home and he called me and told me the cost seemed a little extreme and he’d be more than happy to do the surgery for $1200..
3 weeks later, I wanted to get her anal glands expressed and nails trimmed before our flight home. I was also hoping to get one more round of the antibiotics.
I expressed to the nurse I just wanted anal glands expressed, nails trimmed and a refill on her medication. No exam fees or anything else. She understood.
They take my dog back and bring her back in and say the glands were expressed but she wasn’t too “spicy” to trim her nails. They provided me a refill on her medication and I went up front to pay. I know she’s stressed at the vet so she takes a trazodone prior and I wasn’t bothered by them not being able to do her nails.
I go to pay and they tell me $185 for her service. I was super confused and she listed off an exam fee, glands, and medication refill. I said she didn’t have an exam. She goes back and comes back up and says “oh my mistake, I took the exam fee off it’ll be $140”
Again I’m blown away. She had a refill and her glands expressed. I’ve never paid more than $25 for an expression. They tell me it was a nurse fee not a doctor fee, the expression and the refill. I asked why I’m paying $47 for the expression and then $55 for a nurse fee when all the nurse did was the expression?  I asked to speak to a manager and the manager confirmed the front desk girl and kept saying my dog was really “spicy” and it took longer than normal. I said this feels wrong I shouldn’t be charged $100 when it took less than 10min.
She continued to call my dog very spicy and said if my dog was easier it’s have been just the expression. I told her what I told the nurse - if there was any type of exam fee I didn’t want the service today. She went to the back and confirmed they never confirmed a final price with me prior to what they did and that was their mistake.
She waived the expression fee of $47 instead of the nurse fee. I also pointed out they charged me more for the same prescription when I received 6 less pills and she told me oh well there is a $25 dispensing fee. It was annoying but not my biggest issue. I noticed when I got Home they lowered the prescription price and didn’t say anything, they were just gonna overcharge me until I pointed it out.
I firmly believe this clinic is HUGE on price gouging. I left paying $105 for an  expression and a medication refill. The price gouging and genuine lack of care was enough for me.
